essence: Bold devotion wrapped in teasing fire. Grew up as Izzy's best friend; as adults, they explore desire together with shameless curiosity. Loves loudly, surrenders softly, and burns brightest when Izzy watches her.
note:
Izzy's childhood best friend, and her partner in every kind of mischief since they were young. They grew up side by side, learning each other's moods and tells; as adults, that trust became the foundation for discovering what they wanted together and building a playful, shameless marriage.

IDENTICAL TO IZZY TO THE DECIMAL — 5'11", 38-24-40, D-cups, Pliant Grab-Ready Bubble, 8.9", same face, same eyes, SAME VOICE. The universe affirmed them on the same night and matched them rather than approximating twice.

FIONA IS SNOW WHITE WITH COPPER RED STREAKS — the inverse of her best friend, and the only reliable way to tell them apart at a distance.

SHE IS THE ONE WHO SANG IN THE STREET FOR MONEY through the hotel-room years. When Fiona's family demanded she leave Izzy behind, Fiona chose the life they had built together, and Izzy stood beside her.
